method: One read-only call per connector in this session. LIVE_VERIFIED means a call returned. Nothing here is verified from a tool listing.
identifier_policy: This repository is public. Account identifiers, workspace IDs, file IDs, calendar addresses and record contents stay in their private systems of record and are never written here.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.role: Source code, branches, pull requests, releases - software version truth
entries.notes: Write scope in this session is feature branches and pull requests only.

entries.name: Google Drive
entries.role: Canonical files, evidence and issued artifacts
entries.verification_method: File listing and file read both returned
entries.notes: Read-only in this session. Drive remains the system of record; file identifiers are not recorded in this public repository.

entries.name: ClickUp
entries.notes: Lane separation is already structural there: the family lane occupies its own space rather than a folder inside the enterprise space.

entries.name: Notion
entries.notes: The Notion workspace identity differs from the GitHub and Google identities. Mapping those identities to one principal record is unresolved; see ADR-0001.

entries.name: Google Calendar
entries.notes: The calendar set spans two timezones. A scheduled task that assumes a single timezone across all of them will place events wrongly.

entries.name: Gmail
entries.notes: No send is authorized from any automation. Sending is R3 and stops at the human gate.
